description: Create a link that opens Triptime AI and starts planning a custom day-by-day trip for a destination on a real map. Use when no ready-made plan fits, or when the user wants to edit the plan, see it on a map, share it or use it offline.

language.description: Language for the card and links: the language the user writes in, when it is one of these (optional, default en).

name: plan_trip_link

labels.description: Display labels for the trip card in the requested language.
